name: giftcut
description: 切り抜き動画特化のテロップ編集アプリ
author: kyohei

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.release:check: npm run verify && npm run check:ffmpeg && npm run build && npm run check:dist && npm run dist && npm run check:packaged
scripts.dist: npm run check:ffmpeg && npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:zip: npm run check:ffmpeg && npm run build && electron-builder --win zip --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.release: npm run verify && npm run check:ffmpeg && npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
scripts.dist:home: npm run check:ffmpeg && npm run build && node scripts/build-home.mjs
